items.text: Nutrition label-style summaries are an important transparency measure to help consumers understand what they're agreeing to. That's especially true for complex agreements like terms of service and internet service plans. Glad to see @JRosenworcel & the @FCC leading on this!

The baby formula shortage has reached crisis level for thousands of families across Massachusetts, especially folks relying on WIC. I just partnered with @RepKClark, @RepPressley & the Massachusetts Delegation to demand answers from Abbott Nutrition. https://t.co/htkFAN4EpQ

When the White House announced a national Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health, I knew we needed to include the perspectives from #MA3. Tomorrow, join us and share your insights! 
https://t.co/iHD5lbSi1H https://t.co/s4fHU5AnEJ

Today, for the first time in over 50 years, the @WhiteHouse is hosting a Conference on Hunger, Nutrition & Health. In preparation, I hosted a listening session in #MA3 and sent in our recommendations. I’ll keep working to end hunger & improve health!
https://t.co/XuAlxIqDEd

Last week, the federal government approved a $67 billion agreement with MA that will benefit our Medicaid programs! The funding will go towards primary care, behavioral health, workforce training & more innovative MassHealth programs!
https://t.co/vNPXBdGWeh

Anyone who grew up in a labor family knows a strike is the last resort. I steadfastly support the right of workers to exercise this right when all attempts to reach a fair deal fail.

I’m proud to stand with the rail workers today in voting for the paid sick leave they deserve.

Great to join @wmnmoneymatters team this morning. Their team does transformational work to build the financial wellness, confidence and security of women living on low incomes here in the Commonwealth. https://t.co/UApOwZw6EY

Tomorrow, we’re changing our clocks and losing an hour of sleep. This small change in our routine has big consequences – from more car crashes to worse mental health. That’s why I support @senmarkey's bipartisan Sunshine Protection Act to make Daylight Saving Time permanent.

For decades, working families have relied on SNAP to help make ends meet and get food on the table. I just partnered with @SenMarkey to introduce the Bridging the SNAP Gap Act to improve nutrition access for students, families and those with chronic health conditions.

Townsend is using $742,000 of American Rescue Plan funding to coordinate community service and wellness programs. It was great to join @RepScarsdale and hear from town officials about the impactful programs they’re launching to improve the lives of folks who live in Townsend. https://t.co/OrwzUWTl7E

I’m glad that families in Haverhill, Methuen, the Nashoba Valley, and beyond can go to sleep tonight knowing their community hospital will still be open in the morning.

These are critical facilities that people depend on for all types of care. https://t.co/9OOACi3aOh

Since Speaker Johnson and House Republicans have refused to bring up the Right to IVF Act, I signed a discharge petition to force a vote on this legislation to codify every woman's right to IVF treatment – no matter their zip code. https://t.co/EvHetbd80R

Millions of women like me have turned to IVF to overcome fertility challenges and other health issues.

We owe it to every woman to make sure she has the right AND the ability to access fertility treatment if she needs it.
https://t.co/s9qzhzyXqB

When Alabama Republicans blocked IVF access earlier this year, it jeopardized fertility treatment for thousands of couples. Now, many women are moving their embryos out of the state because they're worried about their ability to start a family.
https://t.co/JSqW2p61da

I helped introduce the bipartisan Creating Hope Reauthorization Act to continue a program that has been instrumental in the creation of more than 50 treatment options for rare pediatric diseases.

Nothing should get in the way of helping sick children.
https://t.co/we6FVuqfxM

Today I introduced legislation to commemorate Overdose Awareness Day, a solemn day to honor those who have lost their lives to overdoses, destigmatize addiction and treatment, and combat the addiction crisis. https://t.co/vVn6Cwfy9L

September is Childhood Cancer Awareness Month🎗️

Some cancers can only be treated at certain hospitals, which can be difficult for a lot of families. That’s why I introduced the Accelerating Kids’ Access to Care Act to help families who have to travel for their child's treatment.

For children and families facing rare pediatric diseases like cancer, the time between diagnosis and treatment is everything.

I’m proud that my bipartisan Accelerating Kids’ Access to Care Act is now one step closer to becoming law! Onto the Senate!
https://t.co/1bZqUCL233

September is #NationalRecoveryMonth, an important commemoration of those who work so hard each day in their recovery.

Substance use disorders are incredibly painful for so many families, which is why we have more work ahead to expand access to treatment and defeat this epidemic. https://t.co/FXOuemBTYc

I'm proud to announce almost $60 million in federal funding to fight opioid addiction in Massachusetts!

These funds will expand access to prevention, treatment and recovery services across the Commonwealth. This investment will help save lives. 
https://t.co/WL5vKbJ47w

I worked with Republicans and Democrats to pass bipartisan bills to make care and treatment more affordable for children battling rare diseases.

These policies will make a big difference for so many families. I'm working to get them across the finish line before the year ends.

My Accelerating Kids' Access to Care Act will make sure that when children are diagnosed with a rare disease, they get the lifesaving treatment they need as soon as possible. We must get this bipartisan legislation across the finish line next year!
https://t.co/V7sNSsw6Mh

If House Republicans cut Medicaid to lower taxes for billionaire donors like Elon Musk:

🚨Children battling rare diseases will lose their care
🚨Seniors will be forced out of assisted living facilities
🚨Folks battling addiction will be denied treatment
https://t.co/hCmFlcKuSi

Too many families in America have had their world turned upside down by a brain tumor diagnosis. This morning, I joined @NBTStweets advocates to discuss my bipartisan BRAIN Act – legislation that will support treatment development and bring us one step closer to a cure. https://t.co/0h4REYXeCd

Every time Trump cuts funding for food assistance and nutrition programs, it’s working families who pay the price. Starving our communities isn’t “fighting fraud” – it’s cutting lifelines.
https://t.co/8lVo8JYy6m
